  • Method Details

    • runExtensionAction

      void runExtensionAction(int index)
      Runs the action with the given index into the host's action list.

    • closeCard

      void closeCard()
      Returns to the editor card.

    • extensionInfos

      default List<ExtensionsCard.ExtensionInfo> extensionInfos()
      Returns:
      one row per installed extension, for the management list.

    • setExtensionEnabled

      default void setExtensionEnabled(String id, boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables an extension; the host refreshes the card.

    • getAccelerator

      default String getAccelerator(int actionIndex)
      Parameters:
      actionIndex - the host's flat action-list index
      Returns:
      the currently-effective accelerator spec for that action (a user rebound, else the declared default), or "" when unbound

    • setAccelerator

      default void setAccelerator(int actionIndex, String spec)
      Rebinds the action at actionIndex to spec (a KeyStroke string such as "control alt X"); a blank spec unbinds it. The host persists the override and refreshes the card.

    • permissionsFor

      default List<ExtensionsCard.PermissionInfo> permissionsFor(String id)
      Parameters:
      id - an extension id
      Returns:
      the permissions that extension declares, each with whether the user has granted it (empty when the id is unknown)

    • setPermission

      default void setPermission(String id, String name, boolean granted)
      Grants or revokes one permission on an extension; the host persists the change and refreshes the card. name is a TextEditorPermission name.
